name: Sap Live Resin Cannabis Syrup - Strawberry
description: Sap Live Resin Cannabis Syrup is made from pure full-spectrum live resin extract infused into tapioca syrup. It gives consumers all the amazing benefits of the 'Entourage Effect' and is much healthier than corn syrup products. Just mix it in your favorite drink or take a shot straight from the bottle!
